annotation.evidence_span: An endpoint MUST NOT send data on a stream at or beyond the final offset.
annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint must refrain from sending data at or beyond the final offset only when it has knowledge of that final offset.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint must refrain from sending data at or beyond the final offset regardless of whether it knows the final offset.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the restriction applies only when the endpoint knows the final offset or always, leading to two materially different implementation behaviours.
